notes.title: New Languages Available in SLaM Patch!
notes.notes:
"Aveggers! Aveggers! Aveggers! Aveggers!" As you can see here, we've added four new languages so that the game is fully understood throughout the Solar System!

✅ French, Italian, German, Spanish!

And more!
✅ Steam cloud saves for when you're travelling off-world!
✅ General fixes to block Mushroomian worms from entering our hard drives!

notes.title: Magic Mushrooms VS Kipzek - It's smells like wacky gameplay!
notes.notes:
[b]Warriors![/b]

It's time to tip the scales in our favor! This is the end of Magic Mushrooms' dominance in the Milky Way Galaxy! From now on, no planet will turn into a puffball! How do I know that? Because I know your stubbornness, strength and abilities! Our friend Kipzek will present his gameplay today - take it as a war briefing and download the demo to test yourself on the mushroom war front!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677590/6fefc729ea46b0568b25f3ddea5ef1aa72ca1ef5.png[/img]
